nodes.name: Approve quotation
nodes.notes: Approval is recorded here (approved_by/approved_at) from the authenticated dashboard user. Totals recomputed in SQL.

nodes.name: Render PDF (Gotenberg)
nodes.notes: Why HTTP: no native HTML-to-PDF node. Gotenberg is a free self-hosted PDF service (open decision).

nodes.name: Save PDF privately
nodes.notes: Why HTTP: the Supabase node has no Storage upload operation.

parameters.query: update quotations set pdf_path = $2 where id = $1::uuid;

value.subject: ={{ 'Your Jetwing Travels quotation ' + $('Approve quotation').item.json.r.quotation.quotation_number }}
value.body_html:
={{ '

Dear ' + ($('Approve quotation').item.json.r.contact?.full_name || 'Customer') + ',

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find your quotation attached' + ($('Approve quotation').item.json.r.quotation.valid_until ? ', valid until ' + $('Approve quotation').item.json.r.quotation.valid_until : '') + '.

Please reply to this email with any questions.

Kind regards,
Jetwing Travels Team

' }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: $json.error, note: 'Quotation stays approved; retry is safe.' }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, pdf_path: $('Build quotation HTML').item.json.pdf_path }) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ html: $json.html, inline: false, fileName: $json.file_name, options: { printBackground: true, preferCSSPageSize: true } }) }}

nodes.name: Render PDF (Api2Pdf)
nodes.notes: Why HTTP: no native Api2Pdf node. Returns a temporary FileUrl.

nodes.name: Download PDF
nodes.notes: Why HTTP: fetches the rendered PDF so it can be stored privately in Supabase.
